content: If the reduction in LDL cholesterol levels is insufficient, healthcare providers may evaluate the option of increasing the dosage of the current statin therapy. Alternatively, they may consider incorporating additional lipid-lowering medications, such as ezetimibe or PCSK9 inhibitors, into the treatment regimen. For patients who are unable to tolerate statins due to adverse effects or contraindications, alternative therapeutic options may be recommended to manage lipid levels effectively.
